// Verbatim from H5P.Video 1.6.67, scripts/html5.js (MIT, Joubel): the helper
// that appends the cross-origin cache buster to what H5P.getPath returned.
// test/player-bridge.test.js runs it against the player bridge; CI has no
// provisioned libraries to read it from. Free names: H5P, H5PIntegration,
// self (the player, with `contentId`) and video (the <video> element).

    /**
     * Small helper to ensure all video sources get the same cache buster.
     *
     * @private
     * @param {Object} source
     * @return {string}
     */
    const getCrossOriginPath = function (source) {
      let path = H5P.getPath(source.path, self.contentId);
      if (video.crossOrigin !== null && H5P.addQueryParameter && H5PIntegration.crossoriginCacheBuster) {
        path = H5P.addQueryParameter(path, H5PIntegration.crossoriginCacheBuster);
      }
      return path
    };
